name: Note Words (HTML)
description: Spell words in musical notes, the way Bach signed B-A-C-H. In German note names B is B flat, H is B natural and S is Es, E flat, so BAGGAGE, CABBAGE and SAGA are melodies. Type any word to hear it, see it on a stave and save it as MIDI; switch to the French system to give every letter a note; or pick from famous signatures (DSCH, ABEGG, GADE) and a finder of English and Danish words made of notes from end to end, from BAGGAGE and HEADACHE to BAGAGE, GEDDE and BEDEDAG.
